grades: High school and college students from Lake County
pay_detail: Pay or stipend is not stated on the page read. Ask the program.
name: INSPIRE: Summer research and mentoring for Lake County students
what_you_do: Spend 8 weeks doing original biomedical research. A graduate student mentor and a faculty advisor guide you. Daily sessions and weekly workshops cover health care careers, writing, math and science. You can return each summer through college.
who_can_apply: Lake County students. High school students who live near the Rosalind Franklin University campus come first.
deadline_text: The INSPIRE 2026 application is closed. The page says the INSPIRE 2027 application will open in December 2026.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply for INSPIRE link on the pathway programs page. It is a Google form. It opens in December 2026.
notes: Check whether it pays. Students can come back every summer until they finish a bachelor's degree. To reach the program, write to Rachael Lange at rachael.lange@rosalindfranklin.edu or call 224-570-7325.
org: Rosalind Franklin University of Medicine and Science
